story_description: Create the EngineAdapter implementation for OpenAI Codex CLI, handling process spawning, JSON-RPC communication, and event normalization
task_description: Implement the JSON-RPC initialization sequence required before any Codex operations can proceed
atom_description: Implement the mandatory app-server initialization handshake sequence: spawn process, send initialize request, await response, send initialized notification, await codex/connected notification
problem_statement: Codex CLI operates as a JSON-RPC server requiring a strict initialization handshake before accepting any operations. Without this handshake, the server ignores all requests. The sequence must be: (1) spawn process, (2) send initialize request with client info, (3) await initialize response within timeout, (4) send initialized notification, (5) await codex/connected notification. Failure at any step must abort with clear error.
scope_in: JSON-RPC initialize request construction with clientInfo payload
initialized notification sending after successful response
codex/connected notification detection and state transition
Error handling for timeout, malformed response, or missing connected notification
scope_out: Actual operation execution (covered by separate atoms)
Process spawning mechanics (covered by ProcessRunner atom)
assumptions: Codex CLI binary is installed and accessible on PATH
JSON-RPC messages are newline-delimited JSON over stdin/stdout
The initialize response contains server capabilities we can ignore for MVP
codex/connected notification arrives within reasonable time after initialized
constraints: Must follow JSON-RPC 2.0 specification for request/notification structure
Initialize request requires id field; initialized notification must not have id
Timeout must be configurable but default to 15 seconds
Must not send any operations until codex/connected received
functional_requirements: FR1: Send initialize request with JSON-RPC structure: id, jsonrpc 2.0, method initialize, params with clientInfo containing name Blaze and version
FR2: Parse initialize response and extract result field
FR3: Send initialized notification without id field after successful response
FR4: Listen for codex/connected notification and transition to ready state
FR5: Emit InitializationFailed event with reason on any handshake failure
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Initialize response must arrive within 15 seconds or timeout with clear error
NFR2: All JSON-RPC messages must be logged at debug level for troubleshooting
NFR3: State machine must be thread-safe for concurrent access checks
implementation_steps: Step 1: Define CodexHandshakeState enum with states: spawned, initializeSent, initializeReceived, initializedSent, connected, failed
Step 2: Create sendInitializeRequest function that writes JSON-RPC request to process stdin
Step 3: Implement response parser that extracts and validates initialize response
Step 4: Create sendInitializedNotification function for post-response notification
Step 5: Implement codex/connected notification listener with state transition
Step 6: Add timeout handling with Timer that fires InitializationFailed after 15s
Step 7: Wire state machine into CodexCliAdapter with public isReady computed property
data_model_changes: Add CodexHandshakeState enum to track initialization progress
Add CodexJsonRpcRequest struct for outgoing requests
Add CodexJsonRpcNotification struct for outgoing notifications
Add CodexJsonRpcResponse struct for incoming responses
api_contracts: JSON-RPC initialize request: {jsonrpc: 2.0, id: number, method: initialize, params: {clientInfo: {name: string, version: string}}}
JSON-RPC initialize response: {jsonrpc: 2.0, id: number, result: {serverInfo: object, capabilities: object}}
event_contracts: NormalizedEvent.engineError with InitializationFailed reason on timeout or error
ui_states: N/A - this atom is engine-layer only; UI observes engineReady event
ui_interactions: N/A - no direct UI interaction; status reflected in session state badge
ui_copy: N/A - errors surface through existing error handling UI
edge_cases: EC1: Initialize response arrives after timeout fired - must ignore late response and stay in failed state
EC2: codex/connected never arrives after initialized sent - secondary timeout needed
EC3: Process exits during handshake - detect via ProcessRunner termination callback
EC4: Malformed JSON in response - parse error triggers InitializationFailed
EC5: Server returns JSON-RPC error instead of result - extract error message for failure reason
failure_modes: FM1: Timeout waiting for initialize response - emit InitializationFailed with timeout reason
FM2: Process crash during handshake - emit InitializationFailed with process_terminated reason
FM3: JSON parse error in response - emit InitializationFailed with malformed_response reason
FM4: Missing codex/connected notification - emit InitializationFailed with handshake_incomplete reason
rollback_plan: Disable Codex adapter registration in EngineManager and fall back to Claude-only mode until fix deployed

Timeout value may be too aggressive for slow network conditions

Make timeout configurable via adapter options with sensible default
